items.title: [2026-06-22] Monsoon Rental Rush — List Your UP Property Free (Image Prompt)
items.content:
Editorial real-estate marketing poster, vertical 4:5 — the QckServe “monsoon rental rush” hero.

SCENE: a warm, lived-in UP rooftop terrace at the first monsoon light; wet railing, a few rain droplets catching warm sun, soft grey-blue rain clouds breaking over low-rise Lucknow/Noida rooftops.
SUBJECT: a relaxed Indian home-owner (40s) leaning on the railing, phone in hand, calm and confident — the look of someone who just listed in 2 minutes.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: clean QckServe ‘Properties’ listing card on the screen — a flat with photo thumbnail, rent figure, a bold ₹0 BROKERAGE pill, and a green ‘Publish free’ button. Minimal, modern, legible.
COLOUR SYSTEM: charcoal #1A1A1A base, signature orange #FF6B00 accent, warm off-white #FCF9F8 for type, one orange used sparingly as the eye-magnet; FLAT colour blocking, absolutely no gradients.
LIGHTING: soft diffused post-rain daylight, gentle rim light on the subject, low contrast, premium and clean.
TYPE HIERARCHY: oversized extra-bold condensed headline ‘LIST YOUR PROPERTY FREE’ with a small italic-serif kicker ‘the monsoon rental rush’; a giant ₹0 as the single memorable device.
EYE FLOW: giant ₹0 → headline → phone screen → ‘qckserve.in’ lockup bottom-left.
CAMERA: 35mm, eye-level, shallow depth of field, subject sharp, background softly out of focus.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: thumb-stopping, high-contrast, social-first composition with generous negative space top-left.
LOGO: reserve a clean ~140px TOP-LEFT square empty for the brand mark — logo placed manually.
